<module id="pe">
  <description>Implement a Multiplying Accumulator for 32bit integer. In the MAC_PE, there is a register that stores the partial sum (the intermediate accumulation result), and in each cycle, the result of “a multiplied by b” will be accumulated in this register, and the “c” shows the value of the register.</description>
  <ports>
    <input id="clk" width_description="">Clock signal used for synchronous operations.</input>
    <input id="rst" width_description="">Reset signal. Defined as 1 for reset and 0 for reset signal inactive.</input>
    <input id="a" width_description="">32-bit input operand A.</input>
    <input id="b" width_description="">32-bit input operand B.</input>
    <output id="c" width_description="">32-bit output representing the accumulated result.</output>
  </ports>
  <implementation>The module implements a parallel multiplier and accumulator using registers and an always block. It multiplies the input operands and accumulates the result into an output register.
Accumulator Register:
The module includes a register, c, to store the accumulated result.
On the positive edge of the clock signal (clk) or the positive edge of the reset signal (rst), the module updates the register.
If the reset signal (rst) is high, indicating a reset condition, the register (c) is set to 0. If the reset signal (rst) is low, the register (c) is updated by adding the product of the input operands (a and b) to its current value.
Multiplication and Accumulation:
Inside the always block, the module performs the multiplication and accumulation operation. If the reset signal (rst) is high, the register (c) is set to 0. If the reset signal (rst) is low, the module adds the product of the input operands (a and b) to the register (c).
</implementation>
  <task>Give me the complete Verilog code.</task>
</module>

generated_code.code:
module pe(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input [31:0] a,
    input [31:0] b,
    output reg [31:0] c
);

    // Accumulator Register
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            c <= 32'b0; // Reset the accumulator to 0
        end else begin
            c <= c + (a * b); // Accumulate the product of a and b
        end
    end

endmodule
